name: Nilaveli Beach
description: Beach and boat launch point, paired naturally with Pigeon Island.
notes: First stop on Day 1, right as the outbound drive reaches the coast — ticket office and boat launch for Pigeon Island.

name: Pigeon Island Marine National Park
description: Snorkelling and beach — the trip's highest-value, hardest-to-reschedule activity.
notes: Boats depart from Nilaveli. August sits within the dry-season "calm sea" window (May–September, June–August rated best). Gets the longest single block of Day 1 (150 minutes).

name: Thirukoneswaram Kovil (Koneswaram Temple), Fort Frederick
description: Iconic hilltop temple within Fort Frederick, close to the accommodation.
notes: ⚠️ Restriction: shoulders and knees must be covered and shoes removed before entering — plan a quick change out of beachwear at Nilaveli or on the bus. Vehicles pass through a checkpoint (ID may be checked) to a large car park, then it's a ~200 m walk up to the temple. Visited in the 4:00–6:45 PM afternoon window, after the midday closure.

name: Verandas, Trincomalee
description: The group's accommodation for the night of 26 August.
notes: Checkout happens the morning of 27 August — the group doesn't return here after breakfast.

name: Velgam Vehera Buddhist Temple
description: Ancient Buddhist stupa, flat and shaded, easy for a large group.
notes: Free, large car park, ~5-min flat walk to the ruins. Only ~9 km from Verandas — first stop on Day 2.

name: Kanniya Hot Water Springs
description: Seven ancient wells of naturally warm water — treated as a short photo/cultural stop.
notes: Basket-bathing facilities get crowded and are reported as poorly maintained; a full soak for 16 people would consume 2+ hours, so this is a 45-minute visit rather than a full bathing session.

name: Marble Beach
description: Air Force–managed beach — calm, shallow, shaded, and safe for a big group.
notes: Small entry fee (~Rs 20–100). Cleaner and less chaotic than a public beach.

name: Kayaking Kantale — Agbo Adventures
address: 85 Junction, Agbopura (on the A6, Ambepussa–Kurunegala–Trincomalee Highway)
description: Kayaking on the Kantale reservoir, right on the A6 route.
notes: ⚠️ Verification note: two nearly identical Google listings exist ("Kayaking Kantale – Agbo Adventures" and a Tamil-titled duplicate a few hundred metres away) — both point to the same operator/spot on the Kantale reservoir, right on the A6 route. This is not the Kandy area or any other "Kantale"-sounding place; it's the Kantale tank in Trincomalee District, ~38 km before Trincomalee town. Visited mid-afternoon on Day 2, as the first leg of the drive home.
